two_pass_invariant.pass1: Original hard budgets only: duplicate locator hard, per-source cap, per-type cap, mandatory exact-symbol exemption; no soft admission.
two_pass_invariant.pass2: If selected < final_evidence_limit, backfill Pass-1 source/type-rejected candidates in original canonical rank order; eligibility requires non-duplicate locator, canonical rank <= limit, source type in required_source_types, and unused capacity.
two_pass_invariant.hard_pass_preservation: Pass 2 only appends; never removes or reorders Pass-1 evidence.

diagnostic_semantics.excluded_candidates: final rejected candidates only (including duplicate_locator and un-backfilled hard rejections)
diagnostic_semantics.backfill_admissions: Pass-2 admitted candidates with canonical_rank, original_block_reason, source_id, source_type, admission_phase='required_source_backfill'

production_diff_summary.logic: Replaced greedy bounded overflow with two-pass hard-budget + required-source backfill; diagnostics use backfill_admissions; trace persists both soft_budget_admissions (legacy) and backfill_admissions.

frozen_selector_local_replay.scope: formal English cases with available canonical top-30 snapshot

replay_baseline_fidelity.reason: Persisted canonical top-30 snapshot omits candidates beyond rank 30 that the original selector sometimes reached.
